data.narrative:
Biobot Analytics is a Series B biotech company that has raised $40M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comparable set of 11 firms—3 public peers (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L) and 8 private-stage companies in biotech and health—including same-stage reference points such as Eikon Therapeutics ($539M, Series B) and adjacent-stage peers including Colossal Biosciences ($10.3B, Series C), Chai Discovery ($3.8B, Series C), and New Limit ($3.1B, Series C).

Two valuation methods are applicable. Stage-progression analysis, using the $40M total raised as a base proxy and applying a 1.9x step-up multiplier typical of Series B advancement, implies $76M. Peer-median analysis across the four same/adjacent-stage biotech comparables yields a median valuation of $3.5B, with observed range of $539M to $10.3B. Public-comp anchoring using the sector P/S median of 8.1x cannot be applied because Biobot's revenue is not disclosed.

The triangulated analysis across two applicable methods supports a valuation range of $65M (low) to $4.0B (high), with a median of $1.8B. The wide range reflects material uncertainty in stage-specific positioning relative to the peer set, which spans from $539M (comparable stage) to $10.3B (near-stage). Revenue and unit economics visibility would materially narrow this band.
